edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the mint recipient address in mintFuego
block.timestamp is compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide when the starting index block is locked
numberOfTokens drives purchase cap, supply cap and ETH value validation and the mint loop
saleIsActive is read by the require gate in mintFuego
MAX_FUEGO bounds totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) in mintFuego
FuegoPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) is compared against msg.value in mintFuego
maxFuegoPurchase limits numberOfTokens in mintFuego
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP is read in the starting index block condition of mintFuego
startingIndexBlock is read as the sentinel before being set in mintFuego
mintFuego writes startingIndexBlock from block.number when the reveal condition is met
mintFuego calls _safeMint, which invokes onERC721Received on an attacker-controlled recipient inside the mint loop
mintIndex (totalSupply()) is the token id passed into the _safeMint callback
reserveFuego mints the reserved tokens to msg.sender
reserveFuego calls _safeMint in a loop, triggering onERC721Received on the caller
supply derived from totalSupply() seeds the reserved token ids in reserveFuego
withdrawAddresses entries are the recipients in the withdrawAll transfer loop
withdrawPercents entries scale the payout amount in the withdrawAll loop
withdrawAll executes a low-level send per recipient, transferring control to external addresses
contractBalance snapshot feeds the percentage calculations inside withdrawAll
the computed amount local is the value passed to the low-level send
msg.sender is checked by the onlyOwner modifier guarding withdrawAll
startingIndex is read by the require guards in setStartingIndex
startingIndexBlock is the entropy seed used as blockhash input in setStartingIndex
setStartingIndex assigns the derived modulo value back to startingIndex
setStartingIndex consumes blockhash values as pseudo-random entropy for the index
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes block.number into startingIndexBlock
flipSaleState negates the saleIsActive flag
revealTimeStamp parameter is written directly into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP
setRevealTimestamp updates the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP state variable
provenanceHash parameter is stored in FUEGO_PROVENANCE
setProvenanceHash writes FUEGO_PROVENANCE
baseURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI by setBaseURI
